A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 67-page versions of the same survey. Their scientific text, equations, figures, tables, and references match; differences concern publication metadata and limited reflow. Neither contains an appendix.

before.justification: V2 surveys existing research and reports statistics attributed to cited datasets. Figures 7–8 provide illustrative examples, not original empirical evaluations. No original experimental, simulation, user-study, or data-analysis results are reported.

after.justification: V3 retains the same literature summaries, cited dataset statistics, and illustrative examples. It introduces no original experimental, simulation, user-study, or data-analysis results.

M1.justification: The personalization framework and descriptions of retrieval, prompting, representation learning, and RLHF techniques are unchanged. No algorithm or model procedure is introduced or revised.

E1.justification: Section 7 and Table 5 retain the same dataset and task catalogue. Neither version reports original training or evaluation using these datasets.

E2.justification: Section 5 surveys the same methods in both versions. Neither contains an original experimental baseline comparison.

E3.justification: The evaluation taxonomy and metrics in Section 6 and Table 4 are unchanged. No experimental protocol, split, budget, or testing procedure is added or revised.

E4.justification: Figures 7–8 retain the same illustrative movie-review and writing-style examples. No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or error analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 5 retains the same dataset output-length summaries, including the reported variability. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information changes.

E6.justification: Numerical dataset summaries, findings attributed to surveyed studies, and illustrative outputs are unchanged. No result values or entries are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, personalization formalizations, equations, and evaluation formulations are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about unifying personalized text generation and downstream personalization through formal foundations and systematic taxonomies.

C2.justification: The discussions of personalization trade-offs and applicability remain unchanged, as do Section 9's challenges concerning evaluation, cold starts, bias, privacy, and multimodality.

D1.justification: Technical descriptions and dataset information are unchanged. The added OpenReview link provides review access, not new implementation, code, data, or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and positioning relative to earlier research are unchanged. The TMLR acceptance notice does not revise the survey's scientific positioning.

P1.justification: V3 adds a TMLR acceptance notice and an OpenReview link and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise match.

P2.justification: V3 adds a running acceptance header and a first-page review line, with limited text reflow across pages 1–3. All figures and tables remain unchanged; pages 4–67 match visually below the header.

improvement.justification: V3 adds publication-status information and review access, with minor layout changes. The survey's scientific content, supporting material, explanations, and limitations are unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
